results.title: Invisible Threats, Visible Risks: How the Nitrosamine Crisis ...
results.content: Investigations traced the problem to a manufacturing change at a **Chinese API supplier (Zhejiang Huahai)**, where the use of sodium nitrite in the process unintentionally generated NDMA by reacting with trace dimethylamine from a solvent[*[2]*](https://www.pharmasalmanac.com/articles/addressing-the-evolving-nitrosamine-contamination-issue#:~:text=nitrosamines%20were%20detected%20in%20sartan,the%20drugs%20pioglitazone%20and%20metformin)[*[3]*](https://www.livemint.com/science/health/the-toxic-drug-impurity-imperilling-indians-11629044573070.html#:~:text=The%20valsartan%20episode%20began%20in,a%20tablet%2C%20syrup%20or%20injection). It quickly became clear this was not an isolated case: as regulators broadened their testing, other “sartan” drugs (losartan, irbesartan, etc.) were found to contain **NDEA and NMBA** nitrosamines, implicating multiple manufacturers – including major firms in India such as Hetero Drugs, Aurobindo Pharma and Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories[*[5]*](https://www.livemint.com/science/health/the-toxic-drug-impurity-imperilling-indians-11629044573070.html#:~:text=Within%20a%20few%20months%2C%20they,Reddy%E2%80%99s%20Laboratories%20and%20several%20more). Diabetes medications like **metformin** were also affected – in 2020, multiple companies (including Apotex, Lupin, Sun Pharma and others) recalled extended-release metformin after NDMA was detected[*[7]*](https://savaglobal.com/is-nitrosamine-impurities-posing-the-regulatory-threat/#:~:text=discovering%20nitrosamine%20impurities%20linked%20to,API%20supplied%20by%20Hetero%20Labs)[*[8]*](https://www.livemint.com/science/health/the-toxic-drug-impurity-imperilling-indians-11629044573070.html#:~:text=Meanwhile%2C%20Hetero%20Drugs%20found%20NDMA,tuberculosis%20drugs%20rifampicin%20and%20rifapentine). Within a few months of the initial discovery, regulators had identified nitrosamine contamination as a class-wide risk affecting potentially **15% of all small-molecule drugs**[*[5]*](https://www.livemint.com/science/health/the-toxic-drug-impurity-imperilling-indians-11629044573070.html#:~:text=Within%20a%20few%20months%2C%20they,Reddy%E2%80%99s%20Laboratories%20and%20several%20more). Broadly, **Western regulators** like the U.S. FDA and European Medicines Agency (EMA) led the charge in 2018–2019: they issued detailed guidance, tightened limits, and mandated that manufacturers perform **comprehensive risk assessments** of all products for nitrosamine formation[*[21]*](https://savaglobal.com/is-nitrosamine-impurities-posing-the-regulatory-threat/#:~:text=Mandatory%20Risk%20Assessments%3A%20Agencies%20have,MAHs%29%20evaluate%20their%20portfolios)[*[22]*](https://savaglobal.com/is-nitrosamine-impurities-posing-the-regulatory-threat/#:~:text=The%20FDA%E2%80%99s%20Guidance%20on%20Control,Nitrosamine%20Impurities%20requires%20manufacturers%20to).
